text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has entered the final<n>stage of
preparation for the Satsuki<n>Sho, the first race of the
Classic Triple<n>Crown. Her focus is astonishing to
behold...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: That means she's controlling her<n>pace perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She previously requested that we up<n>the training
difficulty to be higher than<n>what it was before her
racing debut,<n>and now we're seeing the results.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What did you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she runs like this on the day of the<n>race, the
Satsuki Sho's as good as<n>ours. I open my mouth to
say as<n>much, when...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, Prez.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't Brian. I take it you<n>aren't here to
train?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No. There's a problem. You've gotta<n>come quick.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I'm going to have to step<n>away for a
while. Is that all right with<n>you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That won't be nece—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, you're right. My problems are<n>your problems
now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This way, then. And thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We hurry to the student council office.<n>As we arrive,
we hear voices coming<n>through the door.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...you certain? I understand... But,<n>perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: But... can't... that's why...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She opens the door...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?! Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Brian. I should have known. Why<n>did you get
the President involved?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: We're getting nowhere without her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: She has training to focus on. You<n>can't just—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Coming here was my decision. Could<n>you please
tell me what's happened?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We can resolve this oursel—

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! It's all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
I can't do this anymore! I'm quitting<n>the student
council!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And with those words, she flees the<n>room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not so fast, Air Groove. I want to<n>speak with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You go, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, if I may ask... Is this related to<n>the problem
that you promised to<n>explain in due time?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is. I apologize for failing to resolve it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no need for that. But I would<n>like you to tell
me what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The general manager approached me<n>a while ago,
saying that she wanted<n>to resign from the student
council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: For what reason?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She felt unequal to the task. I suspect<n>that she was
troubled by how<n>frequently she's been lagging
behind<n>in her duties.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She said that she respected you too<n>much to drag
you down.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see... I think I understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She is still inexperienced, but she's<n>shown she has
room to grow. I've<n>been telling her it's too soon to
give<n>up, and it's worked until now, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I can tell you put a great<n>deal of effort
into this. I only regret<n>that I left you to do it alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not at all! I—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Just then, the door opens again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: We're back.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...
choice_data_list: (Looks like Brian really had to chase her down.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Good work, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, as for you...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry I ran...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fear not, I take no offense. I simply<n>want to ask
you to do something for<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I intend to attempt the Classic Triple<n>Crown in the
coming months. Will you<n>come and watch the first
race?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All I want is for you to see me run in<n>person, like
you did before. Will you<n>do that for me?

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Um... I'd be happy to, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. That will be all. You may go<n>home for the
day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Air Groove. I'll take<n>care of this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, I believe I left my training<n>session unfinished.
Shall we get back<n>to work, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure where this is going,<n>but it seems
like Symboli Rudolf has a<n>plan. We resume our
training session<n>with me still at a loss.
